searchText: Would like to gauge client teams' sentiment about also dropping pre-merge headers by May 1st. Doing so would make implementation much simpler for Besu. IIRC, only geth had a desire to keep pre-merge headers to help with sync? I think headerchain is inherently useful because if you can prove it, you can prove bodies too Here is our current notes on the 4444s decision and path forward. Corrective or constructive edits welcome: https://hackmd.io/Dobc38YVQ1qmbbyI6LcFqA I think adding a potential rediscussion of actually implementing 4444s after may 1st is good. just to have it on paper also <@552133098075193354> you may need to update that calendar for may 1st :P Do all consensus clients currently implement deposity trie sync functionality today? For example, if besu drops pre-merge history ahead of May 1, like behind an experimental feature flag, would all the consensus clients be able to sync deposits up to near-head? And is it enabled by default? We would like to begin testing ahead of pectra and eip-6110 but want to be sure deposits pre-merge will be generally available for all the consensus clients.

Do all consensus clients currently implement deposity trie sync functionality today?  For example, if besu drops pre-merge history ahead of May 1, like behind an experimental feature flag, would all the consensus clients be able to sync deposits up to near-head?  And is it enabled by default?
